race.description: Comfort Inn Bay Of Isles Mdn
race.comment: I HAD A DREAM (1) does have a wide draw in this but has shown speed in his races. Has had many chances but at least goes close each and every time he races. Must finally get enough luck to win one of these maidens. Gets a nice claim in this too. STAR ASSAULT (5) will be getting back into the field but running on. Probably wants further in time however a good fresh run is likely. LIKES TO CHANT (4) ended last campaign well. Just needs to keep in touch early. HE'S A FIRECRACKER (2) will get smothered away for a long while here. Might be big odds but can run a cheeky race. LADY VANHUSEN (14) heads over from South Australia. Had two runs to be ready. Watch the betting on here.
